entities.name: rs3746804
observations: Missense variant in SLC52A3/C20orf54 (p.P267L); cited ESCC association report calls it functional, but available abstracts provide no experimental assay details.

entities.name: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
observations: In a Chinese case-control cohort (434 cases, 554 controls), rs3746804 CT versus CC was associated with lower odds (OR 0.630, 95% CI 0.481–0.826); CT+TT versus CC OR 0.654 (95% CI 0.507–0.844). Two records appear to report the same cohort, so there is no independent replication in these reports.
